import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def get_rate_limit_status(ip, endpoint, max_requests, window_seconds):
    try:
        return store.get(ip, endpoint)
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("get_rate_limit_status error for ip=%s endpoint=%s", ip, endpoint)
        return 0, max_requests, window_seconds
